about.title: About HappyDate 🎁
about.intro: HappyDate is an online platform that helps you remember important dates and choose gifts without stress. We combine technology, AI and human sensitivity to create genuine emotions—not random presents.
about.belief: 🌟 We believe everyone wants to feel important. We turn intention and memory into real gestures.
about.mission: We simplify the whole journey: remembering important dates, choosing a gift and making it happen. Technology supports you while emotions remain at the centre.

empathy.text: We design around people and relationships, not features alone.

trust.text: We respect privacy and data and work transparently without pressure.
